targets.rawSql: select incident_id, severity, status, title, affected_runtimes, affected_regions, started_at from production_incidents where deleted_at is null and status <> 'closed' order by started_at desc
select incident_id, event_type, summary, recorded_at from production_incident_events where deleted_at is null order by recorded_at desc limit 100
select control_name, runtime_root, status, severity, recorded_at from security_enforcement_events where deleted_at is null order by recorded_at desc limit 50
